cases.sentence: Когда ___ Саула Ишбашет услышал о том, что Авнер умер.
cases.translation: When Saul's son Ishbosheth heard that Abner was dead.
cases.explain: Subject of the verb 'услышал' requires nominative case.

cases.sentence: У ___ Саула было два человека, которые водили воинов.
cases.translation: Saul's son had two men who led the troops.

cases.sentence: Они были сыновьями Беаротянина ___, из рода Вениамина.
cases.translation: They were sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, from the tribe of Benjamin.
cases.explain: Possessive genitive: 'сыновьями Римона' means 'sons of Rimmon'.

cases.sentence: У Иоаннафана, сына Саула, был ___, хромой на обе ноги.
cases.translation: Jonathan, Saul's son, had a son who was lame in both feet.
cases.explain: Predicate nominative after 'был' indicates possession and identity.

cases.sentence: Рихав и Баана пришли в ___ Ишбошета в жаркое время дня.
cases.translation: Rechab and Baanah came to Ishbosheth's house at the heat of the day.
cases.explain: Preposition 'в' with accusative indicates movement toward a place.

cases.sentence: Его нянька схватила его и побежала, потому что боялась потерять ___.
cases.translation: His nurse picked him up and fled because she was afraid of losing the boy.
cases.explain: Direct object of the verb 'потерять' (to lose) requires accusative case.

cases.sentence: Они отрубили ему ___ и, взяв её с собой, шли по дороге.
cases.translation: They beheaded him and, taking his head with them, went on the way.
cases.explain: Direct object of the verb 'отрубить' (to cut off) requires accusative case.

cases.sentence: Они принесли ___  Ишбашета к Давиду в Хеврон.
cases.translation: They brought the head of Ishbosheth to David in Hebron.
cases.explain: Direct object of the verb 'принести' (to bring) requires accusative case.

reading.ru: Когда сын Саула Ишбашет услышал о том, что Авнер умер в Хевроне, он пал духом, и весь Израиль охватила тревога.
reading.question: What happened when Ishbosheth heard about Abner's death?
options: He immediately became king over all Israel
He lost courage and all Israel became alarmed
He fled to Egypt for safety
reading.correct: He lost courage and all Israel became alarmed
reading.explain: The text states 'он пал духом, и весь Израиль охватила тревога' (he lost courage and all Israel became alarmed).

reading.ru: У Иоаннафана, сына Саула, был сын, хромой на обе ноги.
reading.question: What was the condition of Jonathan's son?
options: He was lame in both feet
reading.correct: He was lame in both feet
reading.explain: The text explicitly states 'хромой на обе ноги' (lame in both feet).

reading.ru: Рихав и Баана пришли в дом Ишбошета и поразили его в живот, когда он спал во время полуденного отдыха.
reading.question: When did Rechab and Baanah strike Ishbosheth?
options: While he was sleeping during his midday rest
While he was speaking with his servants
reading.correct: While he was sleeping during his midday rest
reading.explain: The text states they struck him 'когда он спал во время полуденного отдыха' (while he was sleeping during his midday rest).

reading.ru: Они принесли голову Ишбашета к Давиду в Хеврон и сказали царю, 'Вот голова Ишбошета, сына Саула, твоего врага.'
reading.question: What did they tell David about the head they brought?
options: It was the head of Abner, the traitor
It was the head of Ishbosheth, Saul's son, his enemy
It was the head of a Philistine captain
It was the head of an Amalekite warrior
reading.correct: It was the head of Ishbosheth, Saul's son, his enemy
reading.explain: They said 'Вот голова Ишбошета, сына Саула, твоего врага' (Behold the head of Ishbosheth, Saul's son, your enemy).

reading.ru: Давид ответил Рихаву и его брату Баане: 'Верно, как и то, что жив Господь, который избавил меня от всякой беды.'
reading.question: By what did David swear in his response?
options: By the life of the Lord who delivered him from all trouble
By the strength of his armies
reading.correct: By the life of the Lord who delivered him from all trouble
reading.explain: David swore 'как и то, что жив Господь, который избавил меня от всякой беды' (By the life of the Lord who delivered me from all trouble).

reading.ru: Давид отдал своим людям приказ, и они убили их, отрубили им руки и ноги и повесили тела у пруда в Хевроне.
reading.question: How did David punish Rechab and Baanah?
options: He made them servants to David's house
He had them killed, cut off their hands and feet, and hanged their bodies by the pool in Hebron
reading.correct: He had them killed, cut off their hands and feet, and hanged their bodies by the pool in Hebron
reading.explain: The text states David 'отдал приказ, и они убили их, отрубили им руки и ноги и повесили тела у пруда в Хевроне' (commanded, and they killed them, cut off their hands and feet, and hanged their bodies by the pool in Hebron).
